title: Noise Is Just One Complaint? It Hit 700,000
hook: NYC noise complaints doubled, reaching 700,000 in a year.
closing: When one complaint grows this large, noise stops being background and becomes a city-scale quality-of-life problem.
question: What noise would make you call?

segments.say: Noise makes up 18% of NYC 311 complaints, making it one of the city's biggest everyday reporting problems.
Noise complaints reached 700,000, exactly double the earlier level and a sign that residents are reporting far more disruption.
Noise complaints average 1,918 per day, meaning the city's hotline deals with the issue almost continuously.
